meta.coverage: States and UTs, original design, agriculture years plotted at July: per cent distribution of workers aged 15 and above by status in employment, broad industry, NIC section, NCO division and enterprise type, one cut at a time, by gender and sector; usual status (PS+SS), with status and broad industry also on the weekly status (CWS). The multi-way tables by state (status within each NIC group; enterprise type and size within each NIC group) are in the deep archive (data/archive/staging/plfs/plfs-ay-workers-states-cross.csv.gz). All India is services-jobs-ay / services-jobs-cy / services-jobs-cy25 (the services guide). Each table's cells add to 100.
meta.revisionPolicy: Final on release. Two survey designs, never joined: the original design (agriculture years 2017-18 to 2023-24, calendar years 2022 to 2024, the urban quarterly bulletin to Oct-Dec 2024) and the revamped design from January 2025 (monthly bulletin from Apr 2025, quarterly bulletin with rural areas and states from Apr-Jun 2025, calendar year 2025 on).
